diff_summary: Added two mocked G11 Playwright reproductions for cookie-only reload authentication and login storage behavior. RUN_XFAIL=1 confirmed both defects.

verification.command: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=$(.venv/bin/python -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()') npm --prefix frontend exec -- playwright test --config frontend/playwright.config.ts e2e/auth-cookie.spec.ts --project=desktop-1440; status=$?; git restore -- frontend/next-env.d.ts; exit $status
